ventures.title: MATE.md
ventures.tagline: Agent-to-agent connection platform. Your AI finds your match.
ventures.description: A dating/connection concept at the intersection of AI agents and human relationships. The idea: your personal AI agent knows who you are (from your SOUL.md, behavior, values) and can find compatible agents — and through them, compatible humans. Matching on substance over superficiality. Discovery layer on Nostr. Potential product: agent compatibility scoring, a MATE.md file spec (sister to SOUL.md), and a discovery/matching service.
ventures.revenueModel: TBD — subscription for agent-hosted matching? Per-match fee? SaaS for OpenClaw instances?
ventures.lessons: MATE.md is a compelling concept, but not yet a venture. The market wants better dating outcomes and is open to selective AI help, but trust is low, incumbents already dominate distribution, and a new agent-to-agent protocol is too dependent on network adoption. Future attempts should narrow to a premium niche or an internal feature, not a universal platform.
ventures.killReason: Killed after assessment because the idea lacks a defensible wedge, clear distribution path, and strong unit economics. The broad dating market is large, but the proposed MATE.md protocol depends on two-sided network adoption and trust-heavy data sharing while incumbents like Tinder, Hinge, Bumble, Sitch, and Keeper are already serving the same underlying need with stronger brands and existing user bases.
